source_title: Chelsea news: Martinez could wear face mask - BBC
source_excerpt:
Chelsea goalkeeper Emiliano Martinez has seen a specialist about getting a mask fitted.
The hope is that he can return earlier than slated but his exact return date remains to be confirmed.
